_README: The employer job boards discover.mjs reads when your profile's target.sector is NOT a tech sector and you have no jobs/sources.json yet. A tech sector (or no sector) uses config/sources.example.json instead.

It is a multi-sector starting list: trading and fintech, consulting, retail and consumer, marketing and media, energy and engineering, and a charity. Copy it to jobs/sources.json (gitignored) and make the list yours.

tier1 rows are public ATS board APIs: ats is one of greenhouse, lever, ashby, smartrecruiters; slug is the company's board name on that ATS. Every row answered with live postings on 2026-11-26 (node scripts/probe-sources.mjs --verify).
Do not guess slugs: `node scripts/probe-sources.mjs "Company Name"` tries candidate slugs against every ATS and reports which ones answer, and `--verify` re-checks every row here.

tier2_browser_required lists large employers whose own careers sites this tool cannot fetch (Workday and similar portals, bot walls). The dashboard shows them under 'Check these yourself'. Each row: name, url, measured_YYYY_MM_DD (what was seen), handling.
